---
title: "Suggest an improvement"
---

You can suggest a student question, correction, source, content improvement, accessibility fix or local adaptation. A no-GitHub form will be added when the editor approves its URL. Until then, use the repository’s plain-language issue forms or propose a direct edit by pull request.

## Before submitting

Do not include identifiable personal information, participant data, private correspondence, complaints casework, confidential research, unpublished results you cannot share, credentials or security-sensitive details. Describe the general problem and redact specifics.

## What happens next

`submitted → privacy check → duplicate and coverage check → evidence review → decision → drafting → review → release → contributor notified`

Suggestions may be accepted, merged with an existing request, deferred, treated as a local adaptation, held for more evidence, or declined with a public reason. Submission does not guarantee inclusion.

## Credit

You may request named credit, organisational credit, pseudonymous credit or no public credit. Contributions are accepted under the applicable project licence described in [how to contribute](../contributing.qmd).
